results.title: Louise Bourgeois, The Rage to Understand
results.original_title: Louise Bourgeois, la sculpture et la colère
results.overview: On her 70-year career, Louise Bourgeois has established herself as a world-renowned artist who left an indelible mark on the art world. This film offers an intimate portrait of this sculptor whose art is a reflection of her personal life. With exclusive audio recordings and unpublished personal archives, it tells the story of the artist’s life and work as they merge. Louise Bourgeois is her work and her sculpture is her body.

results.title: Dasein
results.overview: A collection of four different short films, based on Oskar, Gard, Jacob and Marius, each inherited with their own struggle.

results.title: Situationship
results.overview: Situationship is a raw and heartfelt drama that delves into the complexities of love, heartbreak, and unexpected connections. When Nikki moves into her sister's flat for a fresh start, she never expects to fall for Jae - a woman guarding a broken heart. Their journey challenges their views on love, trust, and healing. Watch their story unfold in this emotionally charged film.

results.title: Pod Parou
results.overview: Martina and her three friends, all high school professors, embark on an experiment to maintain a constant low level of intoxication throughout the day.  Based on the Oscar winning movie "Another Round" (2020)

results.title: Franklin
results.overview: Franklin Scott is a gay adult entertainer whose work in the industry casts a long shadow over his aspirations of Hollywood stardom. Despite his charisma and ambition, he finds doors repeatedly closing in his face. As he struggles with rejection—from family, from the mainstream entertainment world, and from a society quick to judge—Franklin forms an unexpected personal connection that becomes both a lifeline and a catalyst for change. This bond forces him to confront the hidden trauma he's carried, face painful truths about himself and those closest to him, and reckon with a world that seldom sees—let alone accepts—his full humanity .

results.title: The Ballad
results.overview: A fed up food delivery worker chooses a split second act of rebellion - one that results in an awkward, spiraling dance between the classes of 21st century Sweden.

results.title: Oranges
results.overview: After an assault, Elena comes head on with her grief as the subject comes up at a dinner party. Things become more complicated when Oranges start appearing everywhere and only the women can see them. Facing disbelief from the men on the existence of the Oranges and of the assault, the women must come together and take a stand for the truth.

results.title: Me Perdí
results.overview: 22-year-old Abril wakes up to find her 15-year-old self in front of her. Together, they explore memories and places that no longer feel the same, while confronting their differences and nostalgia. Both versions struggle to find answers within the different stages of their lives.

results.title: Hotel Amor
results.overview: When the hotel where workaholic Catarina works is sold, she needs to show her skills to manage unprofessional staff, look after eccentric guests and deal with ghosts from the past, which are brought back by the visit of an unexpected friend.

results.title: Sacrée Sécu
results.overview: The whole world envies it; it is the symbol of a united France, a source of national pride, almost an idol! The french Social Security system is celebrating its 80th anniversary. But at a time when public accounts are showing a huge deficit and the age pyramid is reversing, its future and its financing are being called into question. How can this jewel be preserved without causing it to lose its lustre? Can the untouchable be touched ? Sacrée Sécu lifts the veil on the history, legends and taboos surrounding a model that is unique in the world.

results.title: Hazbin Hotel: Live on Broadway
results.overview: Hosted by series lead Erika Henningsen, at New York’s historic Majestic Theater, this concert event features performances of the show's hit songs from Seasons One and Two by Erika Henningsen, Blake Roman, Amir Talai, Christian Borle, Jessica Vosk, Jeremy Jordan, and Krystina Alabado, with special appearances by Stephanie Beatriz, Kimiko Glenn, Vivienne Medrano, Sam Haft, and Richard Horvitz.

results.title: Passion
results.overview: A woman stands to watch a film and is moved to tears by its message.

results.title: Zero
results.overview: Two Americans wake up in Dakar, Senegal, with bombs strapped to their chests ticking down from ten hours. Guided by a threatening voice on the phone, these men complete a series of violent tasks that spark widespread protest against Western influence in the city.

results.title: Homie
results.overview: When a man realizes his “smart home” device is manipulating him to commit murderous acts, he must find a way to regain control over his life.

results.title: The Christmas Baby
results.overview: When a baby boy shows up on their doorstep days before Christmas with a note written specially for them, Erin and Kelly must learn how to navigate their new relationship and career dynamics while unexpectedly caring for a newborn.

results.title: Arthur Rimbaud : Six mois en enfer
results.original_title: Arthur Rimbaud : Six mois en enfer

results.title: Toujours possible
results.overview: At 55, Gabrielle, a brilliant scientist who has just been laid off, decides to take her life back into her own hands: she wants to have a child! Her mother, Rose—eccentric and kind-hearted—enthusiastically gets involved in helping her find the “perfect sperm.” That’s when Gaby meets Pierre, 58, a charming man in crisis, and Max, 26, his son, who’s searching for a father rather than a pal. Between desire, taboos, and pretenses, each finds themselves confronted with their own contradictions. A tender, sharp, and deeply human comedy. Because, in the end, everything is always possible.

results.title: Reinvented Mom
results.overview: Marina decides to take Patricia, her mother, to live with her, who believes that she should behave like the widow she is now. Living with Marina, he realizes that there are many things to do. Both find a new world to explore.
